keySentence: At last, she found a safe and happy home.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She met a tiny prince. They became friends. She was finally happy. At last, she found a safe and happy home.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: In the warm land, Thumbelina met a tiny flower prince. He was exactly her size and gave her beautiful wings. At last, she found a safe and happy home forever. She was no longer alone or cold or afraid. Her long adventure taught her about courage and kindness. Thumbelina lived happily ever after with her new friends.
